children: Proven customer adoption across the broadest range of enterprise environments and continued innovation in AI, networking, cloud, and quantum security
SUNNYVALE, Calif., Sept. 10, 2026
-- Fortinet®
, the global cybersecurity leader driving the convergence of networking and security, today announced it has been recognized as a Leader in the

params.linkText: 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Hybrid Mesh Firewall

children: report and was positioned highest for Ability to Execute for the second consecutive year.

With its recognition in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Hybrid Mesh Firewall report, Fortinet is now recognized in 11 Gartner Magic Quadrant reports across networking and security. Powered by custom-built FortiASICs and FortiOS, a single operating system spanning physical, virtual, cloud-native, and as-a-service deployments, Fortinet FortiGate firewall solutions are an integral part of the Fortinet AI-native Security Fabric, providing consistent protection, performance, and operational simplicity across the hybrid enterprise.

“Enterprise firewall expertise is earned through the trust and confidence customers place in a solution to protect their most critical environments,” said Anthony James, EVP of Marketing at Fortinet. “We believe our recognition as a Leader and highest position for Ability to Execute reflect Fortinet’s proven ability to deliver security and networking at scale. At the same time, we continue to expand what customers should expect from a firewall solution through innovation in AI-driven operations, post-quantum cryptography (PQC), multi-cloud orchestration, and cyber-physical visibility.”

As organizations modernize increasingly distributed infrastructure, they need more than a traditional firewall. They need a solution that can connect networking and security, enforce consistent policies across hybrid environments, simplify operations, and continuously evolve for emerging technologies and threats.

Fortinet believes this recognition reflects what customers experience every day: proven performance, scale, and consistent protection across branches, campuses, data centers, clouds, operational technology, carrier networks, and managed security environments. Fortinet’s architectural flexibility also helps organizations address distinct performance, sovereignty, and regulatory and operational requirements.
Proven Execution Across the Hybrid Enterprise

Fortinet Hybrid Mesh Firewall (HMF) solutions protect enterprise perimeter, heavy branch, data center, carrier-grade, and managed security environments across physical, virtual, cloud-native, and as-a-service deployments. Supported by the FortiOS operating system, centralized management, and common FortiGuard AI-Powered Security Services, this consistent foundation enables organizations to standardize policies and simplify operations without introducing separate products and operating models for each environment.

Organizations also gain the flexibility to determine where security inspection and enforcement occur based on their unique business, performance, compliance, and sovereignty requirements. Security can be delivered from the cloud through FortiSASE, through a customer-controlled FortiGate with FortiSASE Outpost capabilities, or an on-site FortiGate providing local enforcement with FortiSASE. This convergence of cloud-delivered security and local enforcement defines a SASE firewall, enabling organizations to optimize user experience, meet regulatory obligations, and maintain operational control.
Converging Networking and Security

Fortinet’s long-standing strategy converges networking and security within a common operating system. FortiOS integrates enterprise-class routing, secure SD-WAN, and next-generation firewall capabilities, enabling organizations to coordinate connectivity and security policies, improve application performance, accelerate branch and campus modernization, and centrally manage distributed environments.
By bringing these capabilities together, Fortinet helps customers reduce complexity, improve operational efficiency, and build more resilient infrastructure.
Innovating for What Comes Next

Fortinet continues to advance the HMF through AI-based automation, PQC, and multi-cloud orchestration. AI-driven assistance, automation, and analytics help networking and security teams investigate issues faster, automate routine activities, and improve policy management. Fortinet is also helping customers prepare for emerging cryptographic risks while enabling consistent security policy and orchestration across multi-cloud environments.

Fortinet further extends visibility across the Internet of Things and cyber-physical systems environments through passive and active device discovery. These capabilities help organizations identify and categorize connected assets by manufacturer, firmware, and industrial function, while real-time firewall file monitoring helps identify unauthorized changes and protect the integrity of critical security infrastructure.
Together, these capabilities expand the firewall beyond traffic inspection into a distributed policy and enforcement solution connecting networking, security, cloud, AI, and operational technology.
